description: The NVIDIA app is the essential companion for PC gamers and creators. Keep your PC up to date with the latest NVIDIA drivers and technology.

script: if (-not ([Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal][Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()).IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator)) { throw 'Run this from an admin shell.' }

$stop = { Get-CimInstance Win32_Service | Where-Object { $_.State -eq 'Running' -and $_.PathName -like '*NVIDIA Corporation\NVIDIA App*' } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Service $_.Name -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Get-Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Path -like "$appDir\*" } | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
# If a previous junction exists, remove only the link so the installer writes to the real default location
if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $target -PathType Container)) { throw 'NVIDIA app installation failed: CEF folder not found.' }
# Stop services/processes holding the folder, then move it (retry until nothing is locked)
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $target) { throw 'Could not move CEF folder (files still locked).' }
